protocol.name: matched radial outer-layer tangent ablation
protocol.comparison: Same K, q, rate and underlying family. Original six layers and matched +3 ordinary/+3 tangent enrichments, both nonzero and mean modes. The 0.5% reference is provisional for this study, not a qualified 0.1% reference.

note: The sampled numerical-span fit is a representation diagnostic. Numerical rank truncation and fixed FD320 reference preclude a continuum bound.
